note: Five proposed digital-finance examples, not a pure-play fintech universe or a common valuation peer group. Platforms, diversified lenders, software vendors, insurance distributors and banks have different roles and financial statements. No banking licence, underwriting role, revenue materiality, customer records, weights or historical membership inferred.

members.rationale: Merchant payment-platform and gateway offerings support payments exposure. This does not attribute a banking licence, deposit-taking activity or all partner/group revenue to the listed parent.

members.rationale: Banking and financial-technology products establish financial-software exposure. A software supplier is not classified as the lender or owner of client bank deposits.

members.rationale: Policybazaar and Paisabazaar marketplace offerings establish distribution/platform exposure through the listed group. This does not classify the company as an insurance underwriter or equate distributed premiums with corporate revenue.

comparison_note: These examples span payments, diversified lending, financial software, distribution and banking. They are a business-exposure map, not a homogeneous group for comparing revenue growth or valuation multiples.
